rationale: C09 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both orders establish a President's commission in the Executive Office with a chairman, vice chairman, and presidentially designated members; authorize a broad study followed by recommendations for legislative, administrative, or other action; grant rulemaking, public-hearing, and witness-hearing authority; direct federal agencies to provide information and assistance consistent with law; finance the commission through a presidential emergency-fund allotment using the same statutory exceptions; and terminate the commission thirty days after its final report. C10 and C16 also contain substantial parallel commission machinery, but C09 has the closest overall combination of language, sequence, and provisions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established in the Executive Office of the President a commission to be known as the President's Commission on Immigration and Naturalization, which shall be composed of a Chairman, a Vice Chairman, and five other members, all of whom shall be designated by the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established in the Executive Office of the President a commission to be known as the President's Commission on Internal Security and Individual Rights, which shall be composed of a Chairman, a Vice Chairman, and seven other members, all of whom shall be designated by the President.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical establishment and composition clause, with only the commission's subject and number of additional members changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall make recommendations to the President for such legislative, administrative, or other action as in its opinion may be desirable
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall make such recommendations for legislative, administrative, or other action as it deems appropriate
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive three-part formulation for the commission's recommended action.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Commission may prescribe such rules of procedure, and may hold such public hearings and hear such witnesses as it may deem appropriate
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Commission shall prescribe its own rules of procedure. The Commission may hold such public hearings and hear such witnesses as it may determine
shared_material.explanation: The same package and sequence of procedural powers.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such assistance, not inconsistent with law, as it may require in the performance of its functions.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance, not inconsistent with law, as it may require in the performance of its functions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Such payments shall be made without regard to the provision of (a) section 3681 of the Revised Statutes (31 U.S.C. 672), (b) section 9 of the Act of March 4, 1909, 35 Stat. 1027 (31 U.S.C. 673), and (c) such other laws as the President may hereafter specify.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Such payments shall be made without regard to the provisions of (a) section 3681 of the Revised Statutes of the United States (31 U.S.C. 672), (b) section 9 of the act of March 4, 1909, 35 Stat. 1027 (31 U.S.C. 673), and (c) such other laws as the President may hereafter specify.
shared_material.explanation: Virtually identical funding exception language with the same statutory citations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Commission shall cease to exist 30 days after rendition of its final report to the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Thirty days after the presentation of its final report to the President, the Commission shall cease to exist unless the President shall otherwise direct.
shared_material.explanation: Same termination mechanism keyed to thirty days after the final report.
